description: This file contains the implementation of ScreenSlideActivity, an Android activity demonstrating a view pager with multiple fragments to create a screen-slide (wizard-like) user interface with navigation controls.

classes.name: ScreenSlideActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that manages a ViewPager to swipe through multiple pages/fragments, representing a wizard-like interface with next and previous actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the view pager, and attaches a page change listener.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu, enables/disables navigation items, and adds next/finish menu items depending on the current page.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to navigate between pages or up to the main activity.
